summary: Two girls (11 and 12) riding an ATV without helmets went over a cliff on Rollins Pass Road, dropping ~150 ft; both seriously injured; one climbed up to the road (ambulance), the other lifted on a litter by a Timberline FPD high-angle rope evacuation; medevac helicopter flew them out (Alpine mission log: injured 12-year-old girl, Rollins Pass area)
notes: Injury mechanism not specified in the log. | Mountain-Ear dates the ATV incident Sunday 2015-08-09 ("Saturday Aug 8" motorcycle + "Sunday afternoon" ATV; Aug 8 was Saturday only in 2015); row date 2015-08-08 retained from the Alpine 2015 mission log (merged run 526)
